style.name: Wabi-sabi
style.description: Rooted in Japanese aesthetics, wabi-sabi values impermanence, modesty, and the character of things shaped by time. A digital interpretation can use natural textures, quiet spacing, and gentle asymmetry to suggest that material sensitivity.

fonts.heading: Cormorant Garamond
fonts.rationale: A delicate serif brings an organic rhythm; a clear sans keeps the supporting interface readable.

tips: Let a few tactile details carry the atmosphere.

avoid: Treating Japanese culture as a decorative shorthand.
